messages:
elaine_cs: heads-up — noticed a batch of EU imports last night that artificially bumped healthscores for ~1.1k accounts. seems related to timezone handling: import timestamps were normalized to UTC midnight which looks like recent activity. this is inflating renewal risk signals. anyone seen this pattern? :thinking:

samir_eng: yup, saw the spike on our ingestion dashboard. the import pipeline applies `date_trunc(day)` in UTC which for CET imports becomes 'today' for a while. that flows into `last_active_days_ago` feature and the scorer treats <7 days as healthy.

kai_data: diagnosing: enrichment job sets `last_event_ts = import_ts` when no events exist, then feature pipeline computes recency bucket. proposed short-term mitigation: add an `import_origin` tag and a feature transform that ignores `last_event_ts` if source in (csv, manual_import) and there are zero real telemetry events.

elaine_cs: agreed we need that. will this break any ongoing workflows? we rely on imports for historical migrations.

marco_ops: low-risk approach: (1) introduce `import_quarantine` precondition on playbook rules that blocks playbook triggers for 14 days or until verified_product_event > 0, (2) flag accounts with `import_origin` and `import_zone_offset`, (3) backfill a note in healthtimeline when we flip flags so AEs understand why scores changed.

samir_eng: pseudo-rule for playbook precondition:```yaml
preconditions:
  - import_origin: ["csv", "sf_migration"]
  - telemetry_events_count: "== 0"
  - import_quarantine_days: "< 14"
actions:
  - set_flag: "probation:import_quarantine"
  - suppress_outbound: true
```

kai_data: ran a cohort dry-run against import job cohort eu-import-2026-07-05. playbook-bot output below. would be good to get counts by renewal_quartile.

playbook-bot: dry-run eu-import-2026-07-05 complete. total_accounts: 1,087 10-day_quarantine_blocks: 846 (77.9%) 14-day_quarantine_blocks: 903 (83.1%).
playbook-bot: renewal_quartile breakdown (10-day quarantine): Q1(low ARR) 780 blocked / 92 allowed; Q2 40 / 6; Q3 20 / 3; Q4(high ARR) 6 / 6.

elaine_cs: that distribution is reassuring — HQ customers mostly unaffected. request: add a console alert `cs.playbook.import_quarantine.block_pct >= 60%` so CS sees outreach shrink. also show a quick link to sample 20 blocked accounts for manual vetting.

marco_ops: will add the alert and expose sample export n=20. logging will include `import_job_id`, `import_zone_offset`, and `import_user_id`.

samir_eng: follow-up: we'll also add a feature transform in the scorer to treat `last_event_ts` from imports as null unless `telemetry_events_count >= 1` or `verified_by_cs = true`. returns to previous behavior after 14 days.

kai_data: i'll schedule a staging dry-run for 48h and produce a diff of weekly outreach volumes (expected delta column).

elaine_cs: thanks. i'll prep a short enablement note for AEs and set expectations on renewal dashboards. please tag me when staging results land. :thumbsup:
